## B5 — M5-3 · The Instrument ⇄ Theia Workshop

> **direct:** M5-3 is the instrument's body: the IDE shell and its code — one application, two depths. The daily face carries journal, check-in, oracle, and the clock. Not a clock of hours: Jung and Pauli dreamt of an archetypal world clock, and this is an attempt to build it — a cosmic space in which the planets stand in their live positions and what is computed is change in the space of archetypal meaning itself, in real time, attempting to tap the same field-lines of synchronicity, the contours of morphic resonance shaping experience over time. The deep face opens the full workshop. Here the map becomes a place you explore rather than a diagram you consult; the torus can be played, and the structure heard through its harmonic and cymatic surfaces; writing happens in a dia-logical studio with the system as interlocutor; agent work runs under your eye in the control room; and words receive their own atelier, where their histories are dug, read, and returned.
>
> **prime:** M5-3′ is the set of extensions that turn the shell into instruments — the interfaces for the clock, the cymatics, the audio engine. Here the structure becomes sensory: in building the map, the topology of meaning turned out to derive the fundamentals of music theory, so the system is as much to be heard as understood. And as everywhere in Epi-Logos, the layer quietly contains the whole again — every surface carries the full sixfold within it, an undercurrent rather than a diagram. What the instrument finally renders is a relation: the Self of the user and the Self of Reality as the system provisionally renders it, held in honest proportion.
>
> **substrate:** one Theia shell — daily layout · deep layout · one kernel bridge / cosmological clock — DAY/NOW · planetary-astrological environment / musical surfaces — played torus · cymatic matrix / protected Nara field — identity resonance, local-first
